Comment → Community Campaign starts from the same comment/audience operations owner.

Title Refresh Experiment is a packaging-lab workflow.
Packaging Learning Loop evaluates the exact package variants produced/selected by the lab.
Retention Rescue consumes Retention Lab evidence and diagnostics.
Calendar Gap Filler is a scheduling recipe over the canonical Publishing Calendar.
Asset Engine exposes missing slots; Missing Asset Finder resolves them through reuse/generation.
Asset Engine package state supplies Project Package Readiness.
Veo/Flow scene generation should route through the canonical media provider gateway.
Thumbnail image generation/edit providers should route through the canonical media provider gateway.
Multimodal generation adapters should use the canonical provider/generation boundary.

Asset Engine Toolbox visualizes and operates on the canonical asset identity/lineage contract.
Change Journal is a creator-facing projection over canonical action/outcome/evaluation identity.
Packaging lessons are candidates for governed learning, not direct memory writes.
Hook lessons are candidates for governed learning, not direct memory writes.
The full improvement loop depends on governed promotion of durable learning.
Governance reusable workflows orchestrate development processes; creator workflow recipes orchestrate product tools. They share patterns but need separate registries/namespaces.
Keyword Intelligence can be a lens/provider for Opportunity Intelligence but also serves metadata/search workflows; keep ownership separate until product boundaries are proven.
The broad analytics/revenue center supplies canonical data; the Monetization & Revenue Opportunity workbench is a focused analytical experience.
Research notebooks and post-project auto-learning notebooks share infrastructure but operate at different lifecycle stages.
Plan families govern planned work; debugging families govern root-cause incidents. Similar naming does not imply one owner.
